lines.text: The LORD remembers Israel's love as a bride, when she followed Him in the wilderness and was holy to Him.
Israel's fathers followed worthless idols, and the prophets prophesied by Baal, while the priests did not ask where the LORD was.
The LORD tells them to look at the coasts of Cyprus and send to Moab, to see if any nation has changed its gods.
The LORD says His people forsook Him, the fountain of living water, and dug their own broken cisterns that cannot hold water.
Young lions have laid waste his land, and the LORD asks what Israel will gain drinking the waters of the Jordan on the way to Egypt.
